page.overview:
Who is Argentari?

Argentari, the "father of Little Tilea", as he likes to call himself, is perhaps the man who best knows the Little Tilea district of the Imperial capital of Altdorf and his citizens. He knows the names of every Tilean in the city, where they'll spend the night and how much money is in their purses, down to the last copper.

Argentari has ancient Reman ancestors, as he never fails to remind his interlocutors in the tavern of Villa Bianca.
